premise: A buzzy fly pesters the meadow — it tickles Deer's ears and lands on Snail's eye stalk — until Frog sits so still it comes close… SNAP.
inspiration: The patient hunter of the fables (Aesop's heron who waits by the water), turned into a gentle comedy of stillness where the flapping and stamping fail and sitting still wins.

en-US.title: Frog and the Buzzy Fly
en-US.text: {canvas:sunshine 0.6 20s} [softly] It was a warm, lazy afternoon in the meadow. {deer:enter} Deer was standing in the grass, {deer:live} nibbling his lunch. Then… {sfx:fly} bzzzz. A buzzy fly! It buzzed round Deer's ears. Flick, flick. {deer:face surprised} {deer:wobble} Shoo! It zoomed over to {snail:enter} Snail and landed right on his eye stalk. {snail:face surprised} Tickly! {snail:live hold} In he went, into his shell. Bzzzz. {deer:hop} Deer stamped. {deer:face sad} [sighs] Nothing worked. The fly just buzzed and buzzed. {frog:enter} {frog:go to pond} Frog was sitting by the pond. {frog:face happy} Leave it to me, she said. And she sat still. {frog:live hold} Very, very still. [whispers] The fly buzzed closer… and closer… {deer:face surprised} Deer held his breath. [pause] {frog:live resume} {sfx:snap} SNAP! Gulp. The meadow went quiet. {snail:live resume} Snail peeked out. Where did the fly go? {frog:pulse} What fly? said Frog, with a great big grin. {all:face happy} {all:wobble} [laughs] And the whole meadow laughed.

es-ES.title: Rana y la mosca zumbona
es-ES.text: {canvas:sunshine 0.6 20s} [softly] Era una tarde tranquila y calentita en el prado. {deer:enter} Ciervo estaba en la hierba, {deer:live} mordisqueando su comida. Y entonces… {sfx:fly} bzzzz. ¡Una mosca zumbona! Le zumbaba alrededor de las orejas. Flic, flic. {deer:face surprised} {deer:wobble} ¡Fuera! La mosca voló hasta {snail:enter} Caracol y se le posó en un cuernito. {snail:face surprised} ¡Cosquillas! {snail:live hold} Y Caracol se metió en su concha. Bzzzz. {deer:hop} Ciervo dio un pisotón. {deer:face sad} [sighs] No había manera. La mosca zumbaba y zumbaba. {frog:enter} {frog:go to pond} Rana estaba sentada junto a la charca. {frog:face happy} Dejádmela a mí, dijo. Y se quedó quieta. {frog:live hold} Muy, muy quieta. [whispers] La mosca se acercó… y se acercó… {deer:face surprised} Ciervo contuvo el aliento. [pause] {frog:live resume} {sfx:snap} ¡ZAS! Glup. El prado se quedó en silencio. {snail:live resume} Caracol asomó la cabeza. ¿Dónde está la mosca? {frog:pulse} ¿Qué mosca? dijo Rana, con una sonrisa enorme. {all:face happy} {all:wobble} [laughs] Y todo el prado se echó a reír.

fly.prompt: a small housefly buzzing in loops close by, realistic

snap.prompt: a quick, springy comic tongue snap followed by a little gulp, playful
